  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[1;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
  echo "============================================="
  echo "        SERVICE HEALTH CHECK REPORT          "
  echo "=============================================${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Host      : ${BOLD}${HOST}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Timestamp : $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
}

print_footer() {
  local healthy=$1 total=$2
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
  if (( healthy == total )); then
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}${BOLD}All ${total} service(s) healthy ✔${RESET}"
  else
    local unhealthy=$(( total - healthy ))
    echo -e "  ${RED}${BOLD}${unhealthy} of ${total} service(s) unhealthy ✘${RESET}"
  fi
  echo -e "=============================================${RESET}"

check_port() {
  local port=$1
  if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${HOST}" "${port}" &>/dev/null
  else
    # Fallback: bash /dev/tcp pseudo-device
    (echo >/dev/tcp/"${HOST}"/"${port}") &>/dev/null
  fi
}

# check_http <port> <path>
# Performs an HTTP GET and returns the HTTP status code (or 0 on failure).
check_http() {
  local port=$1 path=$2
  if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl --silent \
         --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
         --output /dev/null \
         --write-out "%{http_code}" \
         "http://${HOST}:${port}${path}" 2>/dev/null || echo "000"
  else
    # Fallback: wget
    wget --quiet \
         --timeout="${TIMEOUT}" \
         --server-response \
         --spider \
         "http://${HOST}:${port}${path}" 2>&1 \
      | awk '/HTTP\//{print $2}' | tail -1 || echo "000"
  fi
}

# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  print_header

  local healthy_count=0
  local total_count=${#SERVICES[@]}

  for entry in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r label port path <<< "${entry}"

    printf "  %-26s (port %s)  →  " "${label}" "${port}"

    # 1. TCP port check
    if ! check_port "${port}"; then
      echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}DOWN${RESET}  ${RED}(port not open)${RESET}"
      continue
    fi

    # 2. HTTP-level check
    local http_code
    http_code=$(check_http "${port}" "${path}")

    if [[ "${http_code}" =~ ^2 ]]; then
      echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}UP${RESET}    ${GREEN}(HTTP ${http_code})${RESET}"
      (( healthy_count++ )) || true
    elif [[ "${http_code}" == "000" ]]; then
      echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}WARN${RESET}  ${YELLOW}(port open but no HTTP response)${RESET}"
    else
      echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}WARN${RESET}  ${RED}(HTTP ${http_code})${RESET}"
    fi
  done

  print_footer "${healthy_count}" "${total_count}"

  # Exit 0 only when every service returned a 2xx response
  (( healthy_count == total_count ))
}

  [8080]="$HEALTH_PATH_8080"

  [8080]="Secondary Svc  (port 8080)"
)

  RED="\033[0;31m"
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Dependency check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if ! command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: 'curl' is required but not installed." >&2
  exit 2
fi

# ── Banner ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TIMESTAMP="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"
echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║           SERVICE HEALTH CHECK               ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

echo -e "Host      : ${HOST}"
echo -e "Timeout   : ${TIMEOUT}s per request"
echo "────────────────────────────────────────────────"

# Returns 0 (healthy) or 1 (unhealthy).
# Populates globals: LAST_HTTP_CODE, LAST_RESPONSE_TIME_MS
check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local path="${PATHS[$port]}"
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}${path}"

  # curl writes HTTP status code to stdout; response body is discarded.
  # --write-out captures timing; -o /dev/null suppresses body output.
  local result
  result=$(curl \
    --silent \
    --max-time  "${TIMEOUT}" \
    --connect-timeout "${TIMEOUT}" \
    --write-out "%{http_code} %{time_total}" \
    --output /dev/null \
    "${url}" 2>/dev/null)

  local time_total=$(echo "$result" | awk '{print $2}')

  # curl exit code 0 + 2xx/3xx HTTP status → healthy

    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

  service_name="${NAMES[$port]}"
  printf "\nChecking %-30s ... " "${service_name}"

  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}HEALTHY${RESET}  (HTTP ${LAST_HTTP_CODE}, ${LAST_RESPONSE_TIME_MS}ms)"
  else
    if [[ -z "$LAST_HTTP_CODE" || "$LAST_HTTP_CODE" == "000" ]]; then
      echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}UNREACHABLE${RESET}  (no response after ${TIMEOUT}s)"
    else
      echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}UNHEALTHY${RESET}  (HTTP ${LAST_HTTP_CODE}, ${LAST_RESPONSE_TIME_MS}ms)"
    fi
    overall_healthy=false
  fi
done

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo ""
echo "────────────────────────────────────────────────"
if $overall_healthy; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}All services are healthy.${RESET}"
  exit 0
else
  echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}One or more services are NOT healthy.${RESET}"
  exit 1
fi

log_fail()    { echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${RESET}  $*"; }

  local port="$2"

# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding and reports
# their status. Exits with code 0 if ALL services are healthy, 1 otherwise.
# =============================================================================

# ── Colour codes (disabled automatically when not writing to a terminal) ──────
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
  RED="\033[0;31m"
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HOST="${HEALTHCHECK_HOST:-localhost}"   # Override via env var if needed
TIMEOUT="${HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT:-5}"    # Seconds to wait for a response

# List of services to check: "PORT|LABEL"
SERVICES=(
  "3000|Frontend"
  "8080|Backend"
)

# ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
timestamp() {
  date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
}

print_header() {
  echo ""
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}║          SERVICE HEALTH CHECK            ║${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝${RESET}"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Host   :${RESET} ${HOST}"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Time   :${RESET} $(timestamp)"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Timeout:${RESET} ${TIMEOUT}s per service"
  echo ""
}

print_footer() {
  local healthy=$1
  local total=$2
  local unhealthy=$(( total - healthy ))

  echo ""
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}──────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}Summary:${RESET} ${healthy}/${total} service(s) healthy"

  if [[ $unhealthy -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo -e "         ${RED}${unhealthy} service(s) are NOT responding.${RESET}"
  else
    echo -e "         ${GREEN}All services are up and running.${RESET}"
  fi
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}──────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo ""
}

# Check a single port using /dev/tcp (built into bash); falls back to nc/curl.
# Returns 0 if the port is open, 1 otherwise.
check_port() {
  local host=$1
  local port=$2

  # Preferred: bash built-in /dev/tcp (no external dependencies)
  if (echo > /dev/tcp/"${host}"/"${port}") 2>/dev/null; then
    return 0
  fi

  # Fallback 1: nc (netcat)
  if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${host}" "${port}" &>/dev/null && return 0
  fi

  # Fallback 2: curl
  if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl --silent --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
         --output /dev/null \
         "http://${host}:${port}" &>/dev/null
    local code=$?
    # curl exit codes 0 (OK) or 22 (HTTP error) both mean the port is open
    [[ $code -eq 0 || $code -eq 22 ]] && return 0
  fi

  return 1
}

# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  print_header

  local total=${#SERVICES[@]}
  local healthy=0

  for entry in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    local port="${entry%%|*}"
    local label="${entry##*|}"

    printf "  Checking %-12s (port %s) ... " "${label}" "${port}"

    local start_time end_time elapsed
    start_time=$(date +%s%3N)  # milliseconds

    if check_port "${HOST}" "${port}"; then
      end_time=$(date +%s%3N)
      elapsed=$(( end_time - start_time ))
      echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}✔  UP${RESET}   ${elapsed}ms"
      (( healthy++ ))
    else
      end_time=$(date +%s%3N)
      elapsed=$(( end_time - start_time ))
      echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}✘  DOWN${RESET} ${elapsed}ms"
    fi
  done

  print_footer "${healthy}" "${total}"

  # Exit 0 only when every service is healthy
  [[ $healthy -eq $total ]]
}

main

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are accepting connections
# and reports their status.
# =============================================================================

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HOST="${HEALTH_CHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT:-5}"   # seconds to wait per request
PORTS=(3000 8080)

# Health-check paths per port (falls back to "/" if not listed)
declare -A HEALTH_PATHS
HEALTH_PATHS[3000]="/health"
HEALTH_PATHS[8080]="/"

# ── Colour helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then          # only colourise when writing to a terminal
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  RED="\033[0;31m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  GREEN="" RED="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Counters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PASSED=0
FAILED=0

# ── Utility ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
timestamp() { date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; }

check_dependency() {
  if ! command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "${RED}ERROR:${RESET} 'curl' is required but was not found. Please install curl and retry."
    exit 1
  fi
}

# check_port <port>
# Returns 0 (success) when the port accepts a TCP connection, 1 otherwise.
check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  # curl's --connect-timeout exits quickly even if the port is closed
  curl --silent --connect-timeout "${TIMEOUT}" \
       "http://${HOST}:${port}" &>/dev/null
  # We only care that a connection was made, not the HTTP status code
  local exit_code=$?
  # exit code 7  = "Failed to connect"  → port closed
  # exit code 28 = "Timeout"            → port unreachable
  # anything else means the service responded (even with an HTTP error)
  if [[ $exit_code -eq 7 || $exit_code -eq 28 ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

# check_http <port> <path>
# Returns the HTTP status code (e.g. 200, 404) or "000" on network failure.
check_http() {
  local port="$1"
  local path="$2"
  curl --silent \
       --output /dev/null \
       --write-out "%{http_code}" \
       --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
       "http://${HOST}:${port}${path}"
}

# report_service <port>
report_service() {
  local port="$1"
  local path="${HEALTH_PATHS[$port]:-/}"
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}${path}"

  echo -e "${CYAN}${BOLD}── Port ${port}${RESET}  (${url})"

  # ── Step 1: TCP connectivity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ! check_port "${port}"; then
    echo -e "   ${RED}✗ TCP${RESET}   Port ${port} is not reachable — service may be down"
    (( FAILED++ ))
    return
  fi
  echo -e "   ${GREEN}✓ TCP${RESET}   Port ${port} is open"

  # ── Step 2: HTTP response ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local http_status
  http_status=$(check_http "${port}" "${path}")

  if [[ "${http_status}" == "000" ]]; then
    echo -e "   ${RED}✗ HTTP${RESET}  No HTTP response received (timeout or connection reset)"
    (( FAILED++ ))
    return

  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Timeout:${RESET} ${TIMEOUT}s per service"

  else
    local unhealthy=$(( total - healthy ))
    echo -e "  ${RED}${BOLD}✘  ${unhealthy} of ${total} service(s) are UNHEALTHY.${RESET}"
  fi
  echo -e "${BOLD}──────────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo
}

# Check a single port using curl (HTTP) with a fallback to a raw TCP probe via

check_port() {
  local port=$1
  local http_status=""
  local response_time=""
  local method=""

      --silent \
      --output /dev/null \
      --write-out "%{http_code}" \
      --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
      --connect-timeout "${TIMEOUT}" \
      "http://${HOST}:${port}/" 2>/dev/null)

    method="TCP"
    echo "UP|${method}||"
    return 0

  return 1

  local total=${#PORTS[@]}
  local overall_exit=0

      status_icon="${GREEN}✔  UP${RESET}"
    else
      overall_exit=1
      status_icon="${RED}✘  DOWN${RESET}"
    fi

    echo -e "    Status   : ${BOLD}$(echo -e $status_icon)${RESET}"

    if [[ -n "$method" ]]; then
      echo -e "    Probe    : ${method}"
    fi

    if [[ -n "$http_code" ]]; then
      # Colour the HTTP status code by class
      if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]; then
        echo -e "    HTTP Code: ${GREEN}${http_code}${RESET}"
      elif [[ "$http_code" =~ ^3 ]]; then
        echo -e "    HTTP Code: ${YELLOW}${http_code}${RESET}"
      else
        echo -e "    HTTP Code: ${RED}${http_code}${RESET}"
      fi
    fi

    if [[ -n "$resp_ms" ]]; then
      echo -e "    Response : ${resp_ms} ms"
    fi

    echo
  done

  print_footer "$healthy" "$total"
  exit $overall_exit
}

  else
